contract.name: MockHyperSwap
contract.desc: LocalNet-only fixture for exercising offer IDs without creating intervening offers.

args.name: expiration

methods.desc:
Disburses the caller's own escrowed leaf. Kept for the existing plugin ABI; equivalent to
`disburseFrom(id, Txn.sender, ...)`.

methods.name: disburseFrom

args.name: id
args.desc: the id of the offer

args.name: from
args.desc: the funder (sender) in the leaf

args.name: receiverWallet
args.desc: the receiver's ARC58 wallet app id (0 if not an ARC58 wallet)

args.name: receiver
args.desc: the recipient address in the leaf

args.name: asset
args.desc: the asset being transferred

args.name: amount
args.desc: the amount being transferred

methods.desc:
Disburses any escrowed leaf. Permissionless: once every agreed leaf is funded, anyone can
complete the swap, so no participant can withhold its own leaf.

methods.name: cancel

args.name: id
args.desc: the id of the offer being cancelled

args.name: proof
args.desc: unused; kept for ABI compatibility (membership was proven at accept)

methods.desc:
Cancels an offer. Allowed while collecting acceptances or escrow, and in DISBURSING only after
expiration and only if no leaf has been disbursed yet (`escrowed === leaves`), so a swap is
either completed or fully unwound.

methods.name: withdraw

args.name: id
args.desc: the id of the cancelled offer

args.name: receiver
args.desc: the receiver of the leaf's swap

args.name: asset
args.desc: the asset of the leaf's swap

args.name: amount
args.desc: the amount of the leaf's swap

args.name: proof
args.desc: unused; kept for ABI compatibility (the hash box proves a verified escrow)

methods.desc: Withdraws your assets from a cancelled swap if they're escrowed

methods.name: cleanupParticipant

args.name: id

args.name: participant

methods.desc:
Cleans up participant box and refunds MBR
Can only be called when offer is completed, cancelled+completed, or expired

methods.name: cleanupOffer

args.desc: the id of the offer

methods.desc:
Cleans up the offer box after all participants have been cleaned up
Can only be called when offer is completed, cancelled+completed, or expired
